description: A regular SMTP-to-HTTP bridge (same shape as `smtp-to-http`/`smtp-to-msg`) whose receiver is set via `customer_secrets.SMTP_APISIX_GATEWAY_BASE_URL` to the platform's own API gateway route for `http-to-sink`, which forwards on to the sink test receiver. Exists purely as infrastructure for the post-deploy gateway smoke test (unitysvc-k8s gateway-smoke workflow): it proves the SMTP gateway can reach the API gateway end to end — SMTP gateway -> API gateway (`http-to-sink`) -> sink -- verifiable by polling sink's own `/retrieve` API. A literal, fully-resolved URL is used (not the `${API_GATEWAY_BASE_URL}` placeholder) since that placeholder is only known to be substituted for worker-rendered test documents, not for a live offering's upstream_access_config at real dispatch time. Not intended for real relay use.
name: smtp-to-apisix-gateway
summary: Gateway smoke-test only: SMTP gateway -> API gateway (http-to-sink) -> sink, fixed and unauthenticated except for the forwarded caller credential.
